description: Zones concernant l'energie, les câbles et les pipelines dans la partie belge du mer du Nord is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut royal des Sciences naturelles de Belgique (IRSNB). The Royal Decree of 22 May 2019 establishing a marine spatial plan defines 6 energy, cable and pipeline zones: Area 1 for renewable energy (Eastern zone) (Art. 8§1), Area 2 for renewable energy (Noordhinder North) (Art. 8§2), Area 3 for renewable energy (Noordhinder Zuid) (Art. 8§3), Area for renewable energy - zone 4 (Fairybank) (Art. The publisher named on the listing is Institut royal des Sciences naturelles de Belgique (IRSNB). Its keywords include Federale Overheid, Reporting INSPIRE, Federal government, Marine Spatial Plan, Gouvernement Fédéral, Bundesregierung. The listing shows 4 download or service links in XML. The listing shows 2026-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
